Snowflake

Staff Distributed Systems Engineer

Snowflake is seeking an exceptional Staff Distributed Systems Engineer to lead the architecture and scaling of our distributed metadata and storage engines.

Responsibilities:

  • Architect highly available, fault-tolerant distributed storage and consensus protocols (Raft, Paxos).
  • Optimize query execution throughput and latency across multi-tenant cloud clusters in AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Lead technical design for multi-region replication and low-latency consensus systems.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience with distributed systems design, concurrency, and high-throughput networking.
  • Proficiency in Go, C++, Rust, or Java for systems programming.
  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes, Raft, Kafka, gRPC, and PostgreSQL internals.
  • Experience optimizing cloud resource utilization and memory allocations.
